cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written ten miles in the book like you. That covers last night's dinner guest, does it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's a petrol reading, not mileage. I drove our guest to the station after the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, keeping the fuel record. Which station did that use up the petrol getting to?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: West Station. The express still runs from there after midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you buy a platform ticket or wait in the car? I ought to leave enough cash in the glovebox next time.

reason: Make the copied but misunderstood vehicle record the actual cover for questions around the hidden visitor, using station and departure clues without directly naming identity.
